data.content_ref: inline:The claim's central mechanism is undermined by the specific data distribution it cites: the compile.py 1/9 mutation loss under the shown-to-fail-first installation actually demonstrates that the installation ritual failed to constrain the subject. If the test truly constrained its subject via planted failure, the failure mode would have been embedded in the subject's acceptance criteria, yet the mutation survived specifically because the acceptance surface (the guard) did not record the added-behaviour path. The fact that the constraint was 'partial' (leaving the unguarded path) contradicts the claim's assertion of necessity; instead of the test constraining the subject's construction, the subject's incomplete acceptance criteria allowed the mutation to escape detection.
